en: Black‑and‑white postcard view of a monastery complex seen from a road or bridge lined with white posts and trees. The buildings have steep tiled roofs and a tall baroque church tower with a spire. In the foreground on the right, several women and children stand near a baby carriage along the railing. The printed caption in red at the top reads "Kloster St. Marienstern.", and there is a red handwritten number on the right side.
